title: pilea lucens subsp. triplinervis
intro: Pilea lucens subsp. triplinervis, commonly known as Pilea, is a plant species in the Urticaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Asia, for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pilea include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may help in managing symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Pilea lucens subsp. triplinervis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
